title: Clean F1
description: Hides text display entities when F1 mode is active. Finally clean screenshots.
body:
Hides text display entities when F1 mode is active.

Vanilla Minecraft hides the HUD when you press F1, but text display entities keep rendering. This mod fixes that inconsistency.

**Features**
- Text displays hide with F1
- Toggle via keybind
- Mod Menu config support
